why: Chris, 10 October 2026: "each course must get its own level names". Level emblems for two Grade 7/8 courses, nine each (lib/practice.php PracticeRanks()), the frame bronze to silver to gold as in 2026-10-10-gc-rank-emblems. Fact or fake (factfake: Scroller to Truth Keeper) was added to that request on 10 October but its items are not in it now, so they are asked for again here. Bolt's maze (botmaze: Lost Bolt to Chief Programmer) is new, 11 October 2026. PracticeRankEmblem() draws the old emblem until the files exist. Do not run while the GPU is busy with videos (Chris).
style: A glossy 3D game rank emblem, smooth shiny enamel and metal, soft studio light, like a reward in a mobile game. The whole emblem centred on a plain pure white background with space all around it. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos anywhere.
